# True Attendly Broadcast — Premium Multi-Tenant Retail Hyper-Local Engagement Engine

**Core Mission:** Empower traditional brick-and-mortar merchants with instant digital leverage, eliminating every barrier between a physical shop and its connected customer base.

**Platform Identity:** A zero-friction, app-less, login-free retail engagement system that converts every in-store visit into a measurable digital relationship.

---

## Business Engine 1: Instant Zero-Friction Storefront Discovery

**The Consumer Journey:**
A customer walks into any retail location — a textile showroom in Thrissur, a jewellery shop in Calicut, a bakery in Kochi. Somewhere visible in the store (on the counter, on a wall display, near the billing area) sits a premium branded display item. The customer opens their phone camera, performs one single scan, and instantly lands on the store's exclusive live digital showcase.

**What Makes This Powerful:**
- Absolute zero application downloads required from the customer
- No profile creation loops, no phone number collection gates, no login barriers
- The digital storefront loads instantly in the customer's standard phone browser
- Works on every smartphone — Android, iPhone, budget devices, flagship models
- The merchant prints the branded display item once and it works permanently
- Every single person who enters the store becomes a potential digital viewer

**The Business Outcome:**
Traditional shops that previously had zero digital presence now own a premium, always-on digital showcase that activates the moment any customer walks in. The gap between physical retail and digital engagement collapses to a single scan.

---

## Business Engine 2: Autonomous Time-Bound Flash Campaigns

**The Merchant Workflow:**
A busy shop owner has a weekend Onam sale planned. On Wednesday evening, after closing the shop, the merchant creates the sale offer on their mobile-optimized management panel. They set the launch window to Friday 9:00 AM and the conclusion window to Sunday 10:00 PM. They save it and forget about it.

**What The Engine Does Automatically:**
- **Before Launch Time:** The offer exists in a "Scheduled" state. No customer can see it. The merchant's panel shows a clear "Scheduled" indicator with the exact launch countdown.
- **At Launch Time:** The engine automatically activates the offer. It becomes instantly visible to every customer who scans the in-store display. The status switches to "Live Now" on the merchant's panel.
- **At Conclusion Time:** The engine automatically deactivates the offer. It gracefully disappears from the customer-facing showcase. The status transitions to "Concluded" on the merchant's panel.
- **No Manual Action Required:** The merchant never needs to remember to start or stop an offer. The system handles the complete lifecycle autonomously.

**Real-World Power:**
- Festival sale campaigns planned weeks in advance
- Daily lunch specials that appear at 11 AM and vanish at 3 PM automatically
- Flash weekend deals that run only on Saturday and Sunday
- Seasonal clearance events with precise start and end boundaries
- Protection against expired offers being accidentally visible to customers

**The Business Outcome:**
Complete business autopilot for promotional campaigns. The merchant focuses on running their shop while the engagement engine handles all timing, visibility, and lifecycle transitions without human intervention.

---

## Business Engine 3: Organic Social Multiplication and Live Analytics

**The Viral Loop:**
A customer scans the store display, sees an incredible deal on silk sarees at 40% off, and thinks: "My sister would love this." They tap the share button on the offer. Their phone's native sharing panel opens — WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Instagram, any communication channel. They send the offer link to their sister.

**What Happens Next:**
- The sister receives a clean, professional link
- She taps it and instantly sees the exact same luxury offer showcase — no app needed
- She can then share it further with her own network
- Every single share action and every single new visitor arrival is counted in real-time

**The Merchant's Live Performance Index:**
- **"Total Shared" Counter:** Shows exactly how many times each individual offer has been shared by customers. Updates in real-time on the merchant's management panel.
- **"Total Views" Counter:** Shows exactly how many unique people have viewed the offer page. The merchant sees footfall metrics as they happen.
- **Offer-Level Granularity:** The merchant can see which specific offers are going viral and which ones aren't resonating with customers. This is live market intelligence.

**The Business Outcome:**
Zero-cost organic marketing where customers become the merchant's promotional army. Traditional word-of-mouth, which Kerala retail has always relied on, is now digitally amplified, measured, and visible. Every satisfied customer has the power to bring 5, 10, or 50 new visitors to the store's digital showcase — at absolutely no advertising cost to the merchant.

---

## Business Engine 4: Direct VIP Customer Notification Pipeline

**How Customers Opt In:**
When a customer views the store's offer showcase after scanning the display, a simple, non-intrusive request appears: "Allow Notifications from [Store Name]?" If the customer taps "Allow," they've just established a direct, permanent communication line with that shop. Nothing is installed. No app is downloaded. The connection lives natively in their phone's notification system.

**The Merchant's Broadcast Power:**
- When the merchant creates a new offer, they have the option to broadcast it
- With one tap, the merchant sends a direct promotional announcement
- The message appears as a notification on every subscribed customer's phone screen
- This works even if the customer's phone is locked, in their pocket, or on their desk
- The customer sees the store's name and the promotional message instantly
- Tapping the notification brings the customer directly to the offer page

**The Merchant's Subscriber Intelligence:**
- **"Total Subscribers" Metric:** How many customers have opted in to receive direct updates from this store
- **"Total Sent" Metric:** How many notifications were successfully delivered in the latest broadcast
- **Subscriber Growth Tracking:** The merchant watches their direct audience grow organically over time as more customers visit and opt in

**The Business Outcome:**
The merchant owns a direct, cost-free communication channel to their most interested customers. No middleman platforms. No advertising algorithms deciding who sees the message. No per-message fees for standard broadcasts. When a bakery has fresh plum cake ready, they send one message and customers start walking in within minutes. When a jewellery store receives a new collection, they notify their VIP base instantly. The brand stays permanently active in the consumer's daily mobile experience — even after the customer has physically left the store.

---

## Business Engine 5: Transparent Pay-As-You-Go Credit Economy

**How The Merchant Pays:**
- No monthly subscription fees
- No annual contracts
- The merchant purchases credit packs through a secure payment gateway at any time
- Every business action has a clear, predictable credit cost
- The merchant's live credit balance is always visible on their management panel

**Credit Usage Clarity:**
- Publishing or updating a live flash offer uses a defined credit amount
- Requesting professional copywriting assistance uses a defined credit amount
- Sending promotional broadcasts uses a defined credit amount
- Every transaction is logged transparently in the merchant's activity ledger

**Financial Safety:**
- Credits cannot go negative — the system prevents overuse automatically
- Duplicate charges are impossible — every transaction is protected against accidental repetition
- Payment confirmations are processed securely and credits are added instantly
- The merchant has full visibility into their spending history at all times

**The Business Outcome:**
Complete financial transparency and control. The merchant pays only for what they use, exactly when they use it. No surprise charges, no hidden fees, no recurring bills during slow months. A tiny tea shop and a large textile showroom both operate on the same fair, usage-based model.

---

## Business Engine 6: Frictionless Digital Billing Counter

**The Checkout Experience:**
When a customer makes a purchase, the merchant generates a professional digital invoice at the counter. A personalized code appears that the customer scans using their phone. The invoice is delivered instantly to the customer's device — clean, professional, and complete with all purchase details.

**The Hidden Growth Mechanism:**
Every single billing interaction automatically captures the customer as a future marketing contact. The customer who bought groceries today becomes a reachable audience member tomorrow. The billing counter transforms from a cost center into a growth engine.

**The Business Outcome:**
Paperless, professional billing that simultaneously builds the merchant's customer base. Every transaction is a relationship-building moment.

---

## Business Engine 7: Intelligent Customer Audience Registry

**Contact Management:**
- Merchants maintain a clean, organized database of all their customers
- Contacts are automatically captured through digital billing and notification opt-ins
- Manual addition of contacts is supported for walk-in customers
- Bulk import of existing customer lists from spreadsheet files is available
- Every contact is validated for accuracy before being stored

**Customer Segmentation:**
- Customers are classified into meaningful groups: VIP, Regular, and New
- Merchants can filter and target specific segments for promotions
- The registry grows organically as more customers interact with the store's digital touchpoints

**The Business Outcome:**
A living, breathing customer database that grows with every store interaction. The merchant always knows exactly how many customers they can reach and who their most valuable patrons are.

---

## Business Engine 8: Organic WhatsApp Status Retention Loop

**The Funnel Flow:**
- **Transactional Digital Bill Dispatch:** The merchant generates and dispatches a digital receipt to the customer's phone via WhatsApp at checkout.
- **Automatic Save Contact Prompt:** When opening the receipt, the customer is prompted to save the merchant's official contact number to their phone address book.
- **Free, Organic WhatsApp Status Marketing Channel:** Saving the contact unlocks the merchant's daily WhatsApp Status updates on the customer's phone.

**The Business Compounding Effect:**
Every walk-in transaction converts directly into a member of a permanent, automated viewer list. By utilizing daily, high-converting status catalog updates, merchants reach their existing customer base daily with zero ad spend, driving continuous repeat footfall on autopilot.

---

## Business Engine 9: Universal Invoice Print, Download, & QR Cross-Sell Engine

**The Offline-to-Online Loop:**
When a customer makes a purchase, the system generates receipts across three standard layout formats: native 80mm POS Thermal roll strips, corporate A4 sheet invoices, and digital WhatsApp PDF documents. The engine automatically injects a high-resolution storefront QR code and a direct active hyperlink in the absolute footer area of each layout format. When consumers scan the printed POS paper or tap the links inside standard corporate pages and WhatsApp PDFs, the system securely resolves the shop identity and routes the user's browser directly to the merchant's mobile storefront catalog page.

**What Makes This Powerful:**
- Converts standard, static transactional print streams into highly active marketing acquisition funnels
- Generates high-performance window-trigger layouts for physical POS printing or PDF downloads instantly
- Eliminates app install barriers, directing buyers immediately to real-time storefront offers
- Ensures location context is natively bound to storefront details to direct consumers to physical shelves
- Drives high customer repeat rates and automated return list generation at zero additional cost

**The Business Outcome:**
Every single receipt distributed by the merchant—whether hand-delivered as a printed slip or sent digitally—becomes an active repeat traffic driver. By connecting physical purchases directly back to the live digital catalog, merchants create an automated, zero-friction customer retention loop that increases purchase frequency and customer loyalty.

---

## Business Engine 10: Social Referral Telemetry & Viral Share Engine

**The Referral Capture Pipeline:**
When a consumer browses a live in-store offer, they can instantly trigger a share event. The platform utilizes native mobile sharing capabilities to transmit formatted promotional links across WhatsApp, SMS, or Telegram.

**What Makes This Powerful:**
- Captures customer sharing actions securely at the moment of execution
- Increments individual offer-level metrics dynamically in the database
- Allows merchants to track organic, word-of-mouth growth trends
- Pinpoints which promotional offers are generating the most local referral traction

**The Business Outcome:**
Merchants gain deep visibility into viral customer acquisition. Instead of guessing if a promotion is popular, store owners see clear mathematical referral data, allowing them to optimize their inventory and deals based on real-world organic interest.

---

## Business Engine 11: In-App Browser Lifecycle Compatibility Layer

**The Mobile In-App Landscape:**
The vast majority of customer foot traffic originates from links opened directly within messaging and social media applications like WhatsApp, Facebook, or Instagram. These platforms load webpages within restricted "In-App WebViews" that limit or wipe cookie caches and standard browser local storage.

**How the Compatibility Layer Operates:**
- Detects the specific WebView browser environment at page load
- Implements fallback state-handling protocols to protect user session states
- Prevents page freezes, layout crashes, or loading loops caused by strict browser storage restrictions
- Maintains a continuous, responsive checkout and storefront browsing experience for the customer

**The Business Outcome:**
Absolute customer retention and conversion safety. Regardless of how restricted the visitor's smartphone browser environment is, the storefront remains completely stable, responsive, and ready to convert foot traffic into sales without losing customer session context.

---

## Platform Exclusivity Declaration

True Attendly Broadcast is exclusively architected around three engagement pillars:

- **In-Store Dynamic Display Scanning** for instant storefront discovery
- **Direct Mobile Notifications** for ongoing customer communication
- **WhatsApp Business Integration** for transactional billing delivery

All legacy email marketing modules, newsletter broadcasting features, and third-party SMTP service integrations have been permanently and completely removed from the platform. This deliberate exclusion ensures absolute focus, simplicity, and reliability for merchants who operate in fast-paced physical retail environments.

## Design and Interface Principles

- **Mobile-First Storefront Experience:** The customer-facing product discovery layer and offer showcases are designed with strict mobile-first constraints. No text, image, cards, or interactive elements clip, overflow, or lose structural integrity on smaller smartphone dimensions. Customers enjoy fluid, dynamic digital cards across all device profiles.
- **In-Store Location Transparency & Modal Discovery:** Every flash offer lifecycle must bind a location context description at creation (e.g., Aisle, Section). The consumer view layer must present this via an on-demand modal interaction triggered by a 'View Details' action, ensuring buyers can instantly navigate to the product's physical location within the retail store.

---

**Primary Geography:** Kerala, India (expanding nationally)

**Ideal Merchants:**
- Traditional brick-and-mortar retail stores of any size
- Shop owners who are comfortable using a smartphone but have no technical skills
- Businesses that rely on foot traffic and local customer relationships
- Merchants who want digital presence without building websites or managing social media accounts
- Stores in textiles, jewellery, groceries, bakeries, restaurants, salons, pharmacies, electronics, furniture, and general retail

**What Merchants Do NOT Need:**
- Technical knowledge of any kind
- A computer or laptop (the entire system works from a mobile phone)
- Staff to manage digital marketing
- Monthly budgets for advertising platforms
- Contracts, commitments, or minimum usage requirements

## Business Engine 12: Hyper-Local Dead Stock & Factory Clearance Marketplace

**Platform Identity:** Engine B — 0% Meta API Dependency. A standalone, Meta-independent marketplace for local SMBs to liquidate dead stock, factory seconds, and clearance inventory directly to buyers in their city or district.

**The Merchant Pain Point:**
Traditional retail merchants accumulate large volumes of dead stock — unsold inventory that blocks shelf space, ties up working capital, and generates zero return. Standard liquidation options require deep discounts to distributors or produce zero inbound buyer leads. Social media ads require Meta API approval and recurring ad spend. This engine eliminates all three failure modes.

**The Marketplace Flow:**
1. Merchant lists a dead-stock product from the `/dashboard/dead-stock` management hub. Uploads up to 4 images (drag-and-drop, Supabase Storage). Sets original price, clearance price (auto-computes discount %), category, and condition notes. Publishes in under 2 minutes.
2. The listing goes live instantly on the public marketplace at `/broadcast/dead-stock`, indexed by category, city/district, price range, and discount depth.
3. A buyer in the same city discovers the listing via the marketplace search grid. Every product card shows an explicit "DEAD STOCK" badge and "CLEARANCE SALE" badge — 100% transparent, no deceptive pricing.
4. The buyer taps "Contact Shop on WhatsApp" — a pre-filled `wa.me/` intent message fires with: "Hi [Shop Name], I am interested in buying the Dead Stock item: [Product Name] listed on trueattendenly.online."
5. The merchant receives a direct WhatsApp lead. No platform fees, no commission, no intermediary.
6. When the item is sold, the merchant toggles "Mark as Cleared" from the dashboard. The API atomically sets `is_cleared = true`, instantly removing the listing from the public marketplace.

**Technical Architecture:**
- **Database:** `dead_stock_products` table FK-references `public.shops(id)` directly via `shop_id`. No separate merchants table. All merchant identity (shop_name, contact_number, owner_phone, location_address, city, district, state, logo_url, google_maps_url) is sourced from the existing `shops` table via a single JOIN.
- **Data Integrity Gate:** `is_cleared BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false` — the core business logic gate. The public API always filters `WHERE is_cleared = false`. A single PATCH request atomically flips this flag and removes the item from all public discovery endpoints.
- **RLS:** Public anon role can only SELECT rows where `is_cleared = false`. Merchants can full-CRUD only their own rows (`auth.uid() = shop_id`). Service role used for joined queries on the backend.
- **Indexes:** Composite index on `(is_cleared, created_at DESC)` for the primary public query. Additional indexes on `category`, `clearance_price`, `discount_percentage`.
- **API Routes:** `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/dead-stock` for directory and mutations. `GET /api/dead-stock/[id]` for detail + related products.

**Product Detail Page (`/broadcast/dead-stock/[id]`):**
- Flipkart-style CSS image zoom on hover (250% background-size, dynamic backgroundPosition on mousemove).
- Thumbnail strip for up to 4 product images.
- Amber disclaimer banner: "DEAD STOCK / FACTORY OUTLET CLEARANCE — Final Sale, No Returns."
- Full price breakdown: clearance price, original strikethrough, and total savings amount.
- Merchant CTA section: shop name, full address, city/district/state, Google Maps link, pulsing animate-ping WhatsApp CTA button.
- Related products grid: 6 items from same shop or same category.

**Marketplace Directory (`/broadcast/dead-stock`):**
- Sticky filter bar: real-time text search, 12 category pills, city proximity input, price range min/max, sort options (Newest, Price ASC/DESC, Deepest Discount %).
- Infinite scroll via IntersectionObserver, 12 products per page.
- Skeleton loading states for initial and progressive loads.
- Product cards: image with hover scale, DEAD STOCK badge, CLEARANCE SALE badge, discount %, strikethrough pricing, shop name and location.

**Merchant Dashboard (`/dashboard/dead-stock`):**
- Inventory grid showing all listings including cleared items.
- Per-item actions: View on Marketplace (Eye icon), Toggle Cleared/Active (PATCH to API), Delete (with confirm).
- Stat summary: Total Listings, Active, Cleared.
- Multi-image upload form at `/dashboard/dead-stock/new` with drag-and-drop, live discount preview, and instant publish.

**What Makes This Powerful:**
- Absolute zero Meta API dependency — works independently of WhatsApp Business API status.
- Zero advertising spend — discovery is organic via the marketplace search grid.
- Atomic state management — one toggle instantly gates an item from the entire public marketplace.
- Direct WhatsApp lead conversion — no contact forms, no accounts, no friction for the buyer.
- 100% transparency to buyers — every listing is badged "Dead Stock / Factory Clearance."

**The Business Outcome:**
SMBs with dead inventory convert blocked capital into immediate cash-flow leads without ad spend, Meta approvals, or middlemen. The platform becomes a zero-cost, always-on liquidation channel that operates independently of all external API dependencies.
